description: The train's symbol (R23A, D749), its key: assigned once and never reused. crew.json's crew jobs give it as code, and the CATS train list as TRAIN_SYMBOL.
The name CATS shows on the desk train list (Route 23 AM, OCS-1). Required on the trains on the desks.

The railroad that runs the train, as its train card shows it (CSX, POHC, PRC, HART): not always the lead engine's road (D749 runs behind CR 1993). hartlib.operations.read_trains reads it. Required on the trains on the desks. A road of roads.csv: check_data fails one that is not there.
The number the train's card shows in the train card deck (ops/hart-ops/card_pipeline/train_cards.py): Route 23 on the one streetcar card, which is R23A's. Blank: the train has no card of its own.
The road number of the lead engine CATS shows (4501). tools/ops/check_locos.py checks it against the loco master. Required on the trains on the desks.
The CATS font of the train's label: East or West for the direction, FONT_TRAIN for neither. Required on the trains on the desks.
Whether a crew job runs the train in CATS (true or false, as CATS writes it). Required on the trains on the desks.

yes: the train is on the CATS desks' train list, so cats/data/hart_trains.csv and the desk header hold it. no: an Operations Pro train only, such as the staging trains STG-DEMMLER and STG-SCULLY that the Session automation runs with no crew.

The Operations Pro train name when it is not the symbol (D749 Return). Blank when Operations Pro names the train by its symbol. tools/audit/check_train_symbols.py checks every Operations Pro train name against the symbols and these names.
Free text for people: the train's place in the DS-01 lineup and its work.
